objects.customPresetText:
Even # players: RPS. Loser goes opposite.
Odd # players: RPS. Last player rolls: Even=LEFT, Odd=RIGHT. That side drinks +1 all game.

objects.text: START!

Even # players: RPS. Loser goes opposite.
Odd # players: RPS. Last player rolls: Even=LEFT, Odd=RIGHT. That side drinks +1 all game.

objects.customPresetText: EXACT ROLL TO WIN! Roll too high: move back the difference + 3 spaces, take 3 drinks, and your next roll is cut in half.

objects.text: FINISH!
EXACT ROLL TO WIN! Roll too high: move back the difference + 3 spaces, take 3 drinks, and your next roll is cut in half.

objects.customPresetText: Give 2 drinks to any player, then choose one player behind you to move forward 1 space.

objects.text: FIRST BLESSING
Give 2 drinks to any player, then choose one player behind you to move forward 1 space.

objects.customPresetText: Choose a player on the opposite side; you both drink 1, then they choose someone on your side to drink 1.

objects.text: CROS-SIDE CALL
Choose a player on the opposite side; you both drink 1, then they choose someone on your side to drink 1.

objects.customPresetText: Roll the die; 1–3 means drink 2, 4–6 means give 2 drinks to anyone.

objects.text: DICE OR DRINK
Roll the die; 1–3 means drink 2, 4–6 means give 2 drinks to anyone.

objects.customPresetText: Challenge anyone on your side to RPS; loser drinks 2 and winner chooses a player on the opposite side to drink 1.

objects.text: RPS OPENING
Challenge anyone on your side to RPS; loser drinks 2 and winner chooses a player on the opposite side to drink 1.

objects.customPresetText: Choose someone to drink 1; they choose someone to drink 1; the final player chooses you to drink 1.

objects.text: CHAIN REACTION
Choose someone to drink 1; they choose someone to drink 1; the final player chooses you to drink 1.

objects.customPresetText: Drink 2, then choose one player standing on an even number to drink 1.

objects.text: EARLY WARNING
Drink 2, then choose one player standing on an even number to drink 1.

objects.customPresetText: Choose one player on the opposite side as your partner; whenever either of you is forced to drink by a board effect, the other drinks the same amount until the partnership ends.

objects.text: PARTNER FOR LIFE
Choose one player on the opposite side as your partner; whenever either of you is forced to drink by a board effect, the other drinks the same amount until the partnership ends.

objects.customPresetText: Your side chooses one player on the opposite side to drink 2; their side chooses one player on your side to drink 1.

objects.text: SIDE PRESSURE
Your side chooses one player on the opposite side to drink 2; their side chooses one player on your side to drink 1.

objects.customPresetText: Everyone on a multiple of 3 drinks 1; you choose one additional player to drink 1.

objects.text: NUMBER NINE
Everyone on a multiple of 3 drinks 1; you choose one additional player to drink 1.

objects.customPresetText: Challenge the closest player on the opposite side; loser drinks 3, winner gives 2 drinks to any player.

objects.text: CLOSEST ENEMY
Challenge the closest player on the opposite side; loser drinks 3, winner gives 2 drinks to any player.

objects.customPresetText: Choose any player to drink 2; they immediately choose someone else to drink 1

objects.text: PICK A TARGET
Choose any player to drink 2; they immediately choose someone else to drink 1

objects.customPresetText: Everyone in spaces 5–14 drinks 1; you drink 2 if you are the only player from your side in that row.

objects.text: FIRST ROW COLLISION
Everyone in spaces 5–14 drinks 1; you drink 2 if you are the only player from your side in that row.

objects.customPresetText: Choose someone who has previously made you drink; they drink 2 and you give 1 drink to anyone else.

objects.text: GREEN PAYBACK
Choose someone who has previously made you drink; they drink 2 and you give 1 drink to anyone else.

objects.customPresetText: Your side votes for one player on the opposite side to drink 2; that player chooses one player on your side to drink 1.

objects.text: CROSS-VOTE
Your side votes for one player on the opposite side to drink 2; that player chooses one player on your side to drink 1.

objects.customPresetText: Roll the die; odd means drink 2, even means choose two players to drink 1 each.

objects.text: LUCKY FIFTEEN
Roll the die; odd means drink 2, even means choose two players to drink 1 each.

objects.customPresetText: Roll; 1–3 means drink 2, 4–6 means choose two players on opposite sides to drink 1.

objects.text: FIFTEEN CHANCE
Roll; 1–3 means drink 2, 4–6 means choose two players on opposite sides to drink 1.

objects.customPresetText: Challenge any player on your side to a die roll; loser drinks 3, winner chooses someone opposite to drink 2.

objects.text: SAME-SIDE SHOWDOWN
Challenge any player on your side to a die roll; loser drinks 3, winner chooses someone opposite to drink 2.

objects.customPresetText: Pick two players on your side to roll; lower roll drinks 3, higher roll chooses one opponent to drink 2.

objects.text: CHALLENGE THE PACK
Pick two players on your side to roll; lower roll drinks 3, higher roll chooses one opponent to drink 2.

objects.customPresetText: Choose a player ahead of you; they drink 2, then they choose whether you or another player drinks 1.

objects.text: TAKE THE HEAT
Choose a player ahead of you; they drink 2, then they choose whether you or another player drinks 1.

objects.customPresetText: Choose any player ahead of you; they drink 3, then choose someone behind them to drink 2.

objects.text: WILD TARGET
Choose any player ahead of you; they drink 3, then choose someone behind them to drink 2.

objects.customPresetText: The player standing on 18 on the opposite side drinks 2; if nobody is there, everyone on the opposite side drinks 1.

objects.text: MIRROR PAIN
The player standing on 18 on the opposite side drinks 2; if nobody is there, everyone on the opposite side drinks 1.

objects.customPresetText: Everyone standing on 18 or the matching opposite space drinks 2; anyone without a mirror opponent chooses someone else to drink 1.

objects.text: DOUBLE EIGHTEEN
Everyone standing on 18 or the matching opposite space drinks 2; anyone without a mirror opponent chooses someone else to drink 1.

objects.customPresetText: Choose a player on the opposite side as your partner; whenever either of you is forced to drink by a board effect, the other drinks the same amount until the partnership ends.

objects.text: SECOND CHANCE PARTNER
Choose a player on the opposite side as your partner; whenever either of you is forced to drink by a board effect, the other drinks the same amount until the partnership ends.

objects.customPresetText: Move forward 2 spaces and give 2 drinks to a player on the opposite side.

objects.text: GREEN BOOST
Move forward 2 spaces and give 2 drinks to a player on the opposite side.

objects.customPresetText: The side with fewer players chooses two people on the larger side to drink 2 each.

objects.text: SIDE BALANCE
The side with fewer players chooses two people on the larger side to drink 2 each.

objects.customPresetText: Choose an opponent; you both drink 1, then each choose another player on your own side to drink 1.

objects.text: CROSS-SIDE TRUCE
Choose an opponent; you both drink 1, then each choose another player on your own side to drink 1.

objects.customPresetText: Everyone on an odd-numbered space drinks 1; if you are on an odd number, choose one even-numbered player to drink 2 instead.

objects.text: ODD MAN OUT
Everyone on an odd-numbered space drinks 1; if you are on an odd number, choose one even-numbered player to drink 2 instead.

objects.customPresetText: Everyone on an even number drinks 1; everyone on an odd number chooses one player on the opposite side to drink 1.

objects.text: EVENING CHAOS
Everyone on an even number drinks 1; everyone on an odd number chooses one player on the opposite side to drink 1.

objects.customPresetText: Challenge the player closest to FINISH on your side; loser drinks 3, winner chooses two players opposite to drink 1 each.

objects.text: LEADER HUNT
Challenge the player closest to FINISH on your side; loser drinks 3, winner chooses two players opposite to drink 1 each.

objects.customPresetText: Challenge the player closest to FINISH on either side; loser drinks 4, winner gives 2 drinks to someone else.

objects.text: CLOSEST TO WIN
Challenge the player closest to FINISH on either side; loser drinks 4, winner gives 2 drinks to someone else.

objects.customPresetText: Pick any number between 1–23; everyone standing on that number drinks 2, regardless of side.

objects.text: NUMBER RAID
Pick any number between 1–23; everyone standing on that number drinks 2, regardless of side.

objects.customPresetText: Choose any number between 1–44; everyone standing on that number drinks 2, but you choose the number secretly before announcing it.

objects.text: CHAOS NUMBER
Choose any number between 1–44; everyone standing on that number drinks 2, but you choose the number secretly before announcing it.

objects.customPresetText: Everyone in spaces 15–24 drinks 2; anyone sharing their number with an opponent drinks 1 extra.

objects.text: ROW BREAKER
Everyone in spaces 15–24 drinks 2; anyone sharing their number with an opponent drinks 1 extra.

objects.customPresetText: Everyone in spaces 15–24 drinks 2; the player farthest from FINISH in that section drinks 1 extra.

objects.text: ROW 24 MELTDOWN
Everyone in spaces 15–24 drinks 2; the player farthest from FINISH in that section drinks 1 extra.

objects.customPresetText: Move forward 2 spaces and give 2 drinks to any player.

objects.text: GREEN MOMENTUM
Move forward 2 spaces and give 2 drinks to any player.

objects.customPresetText: Choose any player on the opposite side to drink 3; then give 1 drink to a player on your side.

objects.text: GREEN STRIKE
Choose any player on the opposite side to drink 3; then give 1 drink to a player on your side.

objects.customPresetText: Count the players ahead of you on the opposite side; each one adds 1 drink to the player closest to FINISH on your side, maximum 3.

objects.text: OPPOSITE TAX
Count the players ahead of you on the opposite side; each one adds 1 drink to the player closest to FINISH on your side, maximum 3.

objects.customPresetText: Your side chooses two opponents to drink 2 each; the opposite side chooses one player on your side to drink 3.

objects.text: SIDE HEAT
Your side chooses two opponents to drink 2 each; the opposite side chooses one player on your side to drink 3.

objects.customPresetText: Roll; 5–6 means choose three players to drink 1, 3–4 means drink 2, 1–2 means drink 3 and move back 1.

objects.text: ROLL THE RISK
Roll; 5–6 means choose three players to drink 1, 3–4 means drink 2, 1–2 means drink 3 and move back 1.

objects.customPresetText: Roll; high means give 3 drinks to anyone, low means drink 3 yourself.

objects.text: HIGH OR LOW
Roll; high means give 3 drinks to anyone, low means drink 3 yourself.

objects.customPresetText: Challenge the player farthest behind on your side; loser drinks 3, winner moves forward 1 and gives 1 drink.

objects.text: SIDE CHAMPION
Challenge the player farthest behind on your side; loser drinks 3, winner moves forward 1 and gives 1 drink.

objects.customPresetText: Challenge the player currently in last place; loser drinks 4, winner moves forward 1. Highest dice roll win.

objects.text: LAST PLACE DUEL
Challenge the player currently in last place; loser drinks 4, winner moves forward 1. Highest dice roll win.

objects.customPresetText: Choose two existing partner pairs and swap their partners; if there are no active partnerships, choose four players to drink 1 instead.

objects.text: PARTNER SWAP
Choose two existing partner pairs and swap their partners; if there are no active partnerships, choose four players to drink 1 instead.

objects.customPresetText: Swap positions with the player on the opposite side who is closest to your number; if either has a partner, their partner follows them.

objects.text: POSITION RAID
Swap positions with the player on the opposite side who is closest to your number; if either has a partner, their partner follows them.

objects.customPresetText: Everyone in spaces 25–34 drinks 2; you drink 3 if you are the only player from your side in that section.

objects.text: MASS DAMAGE
Everyone in spaces 25–34 drinks 2; you drink 3 if you are the only player from your side in that section.

objects.customPresetText: Everyone in spaces 25–34 drinks 2; anyone on an odd number drinks 1 extra.

objects.text: THIRTY'S WRATH
Everyone in spaces 25–34 drinks 2; anyone on an odd number drinks 1 extra.

objects.customPresetText: If you are not in first place, move forward 2 and give 2 drinks; if you are in first, choose two players to drink 2.

objects.text: COMEBACK BOOST
If you are not in first place, move forward 2 and give 2 drinks; if you are in first, choose two players to drink 2.

objects.customPresetText: If you're not in first, move forward 2 and choose one player to drink 2; if you're first, drink 3 instead.

objects.text: GREEN COMEBACK
If you're not in first, move forward 2 and choose one player to drink 2; if you're first, drink 3 instead.

objects.customPresetText: Anyone standing on 32 or directly opposite 32 drinks 2; if only one space is occupied, that player drinks 3.

objects.text: MIRROR TAX
Anyone standing on 32 or directly opposite 32 drinks 2; if only one space is occupied, that player drinks 3.

objects.customPresetText: Compare your position with the player closest to 32 on the opposite side; whoever is farther from FINISH drinks 3.

objects.text: WHO'S CLOSER
Compare your position with the player closest to 32 on the opposite side; whoever is farther from FINISH drinks 3.

objects.customPresetText: Pick two players; all three roll, lowest roll drinks 3, highest roll gives 2 drinks, middle roll drinks 1.

objects.text: THREE-WAY ROLL
Pick two players; all three roll, lowest roll drinks 3, highest roll gives 2 drinks, middle roll drinks 1.

objects.customPresetText: Roll; everyone whose number matches the roll or is a multiple of it drinks 2.

objects.text: ROLLING NUMBERS
Roll; everyone whose number matches the roll or is a multiple of it drinks 2.

objects.customPresetText: Challenge anyone ahead of you on your side; loser drinks 4, winner chooses two players opposite to drink 1.

objects.text: FINAL MIDGAME DUEL
Challenge anyone ahead of you on your side; loser drinks 4, winner chooses two players opposite to drink 1.

objects.customPresetText: Challenge anyone ahead of you; loser drinks 4, winner chooses two opponents to drink 1 each.

objects.text: FINAL MIDGAME FIGHT
Challenge anyone ahead of you; loser drinks 4, winner chooses two opponents to drink 1 each.

objects.customPresetText: End every active partnership; anyone whose partner was removed drinks 2.

objects.text: BREAK THE BONDS
End every active partnership; anyone whose partner was removed drinks 2.

objects.customPresetText: End every active partnership; anyone whose partner disappears drinks 2.

objects.text: BREAK EVERY BOND
End every active partnership; anyone whose partner disappears drinks 2.

objects.customPresetText: Everyone in spaces 35–44 drinks 2; you choose one opponent to drink 2 more.

objects.text: ENDGAME BEGINS
Everyone in spaces 35–44 drinks 2; you choose one opponent to drink 2 more.

objects.customPresetText: Everyone in spaces 35–44 drinks 2; the player closest to FINISH on your side drinks 3.

objects.text: ENDGAME PUNISHMENT
Everyone in spaces 35–44 drinks 2; the player closest to FINISH on your side drinks 3.

objects.customPresetText: Choose any player behind you to drink 3; then choose any player ahead of you to drink 1.

objects.text: LAST GREEN GIFT
Choose any player behind you to drink 3; then choose any player ahead of you to drink 1.

objects.customPresetText: Choose one player behind you to drink 3 and one player ahead of you to drink 2; no movement allowed.

objects.text: GREEN LAST CHANCE
Choose one player behind you to drink 3 and one player ahead of you to drink 2; no movement allowed.

objects.customPresetText: Everyone standing on 38 or the matching number opposite drinks 3; if both are occupied, each chooses another player to drink 1.

objects.text: MIRROR EXECUTION
Everyone standing on 38 or the matching number opposite drinks 3; if both are occupied, each chooses another player to drink 1.

objects.customPresetText: Anyone standing on 38 or the matching opposite number drinks 3; each affected player chooses someone else to drink 1.

objects.text: MIRROR MAYHEM
Anyone standing on 38 or the matching opposite number drinks 3; each affected player chooses someone else to drink 1.

objects.customPresetText: Odd-numbered players in spaces 35–44 drink 2; even-numbered players choose one opponent to drink 2.

objects.text: FINAL ODDS
Odd-numbered players in spaces 35–44 drink 2; even-numbered players choose one opponent to drink 2.

objects.customPresetText: Roll; 1–3 means drink 3, 4–6 means choose three different players to drink 1 each.

objects.text: ENDGAME GAMBLE
Roll; 1–3 means drink 3, 4–6 means choose three different players to drink 1 each.

objects.customPresetText: Challenge any player on your side; loser drinks 4, winner chooses two players opposite to drink 2 each.

objects.text: ENDGAME DUEL
Challenge any player on your side; loser drinks 4, winner chooses two players opposite to drink 2 each.

objects.customPresetText: Challenge the player closest to FINISH on the opposite side; loser drinks 4, winner chooses two players to drink 2 each.

objects.text: FINAL FOUR
Challenge the player closest to FINISH on the opposite side; loser drinks 4, winner chooses two players to drink 2 each.

objects.customPresetText: The player closest to FINISH on your side drinks 3; they choose someone on the opposite side to drink 2.

objects.text: LEADER'S NIGHTMARE
The player closest to FINISH on your side drinks 3; they choose someone on the opposite side to drink 2.

objects.customPresetText: Swap positions with the player currently in last place; if either player has a partner, their partner comes with them.

objects.text: LAST PLACE SWAP
Swap positions with the player currently in last place; if either player has a partner, their partner comes with them.

objects.customPresetText: Everyone in spaces 35–44 drinks 3; anyone sharing their number with an opponent drinks 1 extra.

objects.text: NO SAFE ROW
Everyone in spaces 35–44 drinks 3; anyone sharing their number with an opponent drinks 1 extra.

objects.customPresetText: Everyone in spaces 35–44 drinks 3; anyone sharing a number with an opponent drinks 1 extra.

objects.text: THE GAUNTLET
Everyone in spaces 35–44 drinks 3; anyone sharing a number with an opponent drinks 1 extra.

objects.customPresetText: Give 3 drinks to any player behind you and choose one opponent to drink 2; no movement allowed.

objects.text: LAST REWARD
Give 3 drinks to any player behind you and choose one opponent to drink 2; no movement allowed.

objects.customPresetText: Choose any two players to drink 2 each; if one is ahead of you, they must also give 1 drink to someone else.

objects.text: GREEN BEFORE THE END
Choose any two players to drink 2 each; if one is ahead of you, they must also give 1 drink to someone else.

objects.customPresetText: Your side chooses one opponent to drink 4; their side chooses one player on your side to drink 4; everyone standing on 44 drinks 2.

objects.text: LAST STAND
Your side chooses one opponent to drink 4; their side chooses one player on your side to drink 4; everyone standing on 44 drinks 2.

objects.customPresetText: Everyone standing on 44 drinks 3; each side chooses one other player to drink 2, then the player farthest from FINISH drinks 1 extra.

objects.text: FINAL CHAOS
Everyone standing on 44 drinks 3; each side chooses one other player to drink 2, then the player farthest from FINISH drinks 1 extra.

objects.customPresetText: Move forward 1 space and choose any player on your side to drink 2.

objects.text: LUCKY START
Move forward 1 space and choose any player on your side to drink 2.

objects.customPresetText: Pick a player on the opposite side; they drink 2, then choose someone from your side to drink 1.

objects.text: OTHER SIDE PROBLEM
Pick a player on the opposite side; they drink 2, then choose someone from your side to drink 1.

objects.customPresetText: Roll the die; odd means give 2 drinks to one player, even means split 2 drinks between two players.

objects.text: ROLLING FAVOR
Roll the die; odd means give 2 drinks to one player, even means split 2 drinks between two players.

objects.customPresetText: Challenge someone on your side to RPS; loser drinks 2 and winner may give 1 drink to anyone.

objects.text: RIGHT-SIDE RIVAL
Challenge someone on your side to RPS; loser drinks 2 and winner may give 1 drink to anyone.

objects.customPresetText: Pick three players; everyone votes which one drinks 3, but the player receiving the most votes chooses one other player to drink 1.

objects.text: CHAOS VOTE
Pick three players; everyone votes which one drinks 3, but the player receiving the most votes chooses one other player to drink 1.

objects.customPresetText: Drink 2; every player on a number divisible by 3 drinks 1.

objects.text: SIX FEET UNDER
Drink 2; every player on a number divisible by 3 drinks 1.

objects.customPresetText: Choose any player on the opposite side; they drink 2 and you may move forward 1.

objects.text: GREEN FAVOR
Choose any player on the opposite side; they drink 2 and you may move forward 1.

objects.customPresetText: The player on 8 opposite you drinks 2; if that space is empty, choose anyone on the opposite side to drink 2.

objects.text: SIDE MIRROR
The player on 8 opposite you drinks 2; if that space is empty, choose anyone on the opposite side to drink 2.

objects.customPresetText: Roll; 1–2 drink 3, 3–4 give 2 drinks, 5–6 choose one player to drink 3.

objects.text: NINE LIVES
Roll; 1–2 drink 3, 3–4 give 2 drinks, 5–6 choose one player to drink 3.

objects.customPresetText: Challenge the player farthest ahead on your side; loser drinks 3, winner chooses one opponent to drink 2.

objects.text: DUEL OF DISTANCE
Challenge the player farthest ahead on your side; loser drinks 3, winner chooses one opponent to drink 2.

objects.customPresetText: Choose someone to drink 2; they choose another person to drink 2; you decide whether the chain ends or one more person drinks 1.

objects.text: PASS THE PROBLEM
Choose someone to drink 2; they choose another person to drink 2; you decide whether the chain ends or one more person drinks 1.

objects.customPresetText: Everyone in spaces 5–14 drinks 1; the player closest to FINISH in that row drinks 2.

objects.text: ROW CRASH
Everyone in spaces 5–14 drinks 1; the player closest to FINISH in that row drinks 2.

objects.customPresetText: Choose any player who is ahead of you; they drink 2 and you move forward 1.

objects.text: GREEN REVENGE
Choose any player who is ahead of you; they drink 2 and you move forward 1.

objects.customPresetText: Your side picks one opponent to drink 2; their side picks one player on your side to drink 2.

objects.text: DOUBLE-SIDE VOTE
Your side picks one opponent to drink 2; their side picks one player on your side to drink 2.
